name: Pair of boots
dimensions: Length 17 cm; Height 22.5 cm; Width 5.8 cm
summary:
This pair of embroidered silk boots were made to be worn by a young Manchu boy in China during the Qing dynasty. They were made 'straight', so they have no left or right, and have platform soles made of stacked paper and felt. They are lined with bright pink fabric.
